title: Contents of the place of assembly certificate of operation.
officialText: The certificate of operation shall contain the place of assembly certificate number, the number of persons who may legally occupy the space and any other information that the com-missioner may determine. Such certificate of operation shall be framed and mounted in a location that is conspicuously visible to a person entering the space. For the purposes of this article a department issued place of assembly permit or place of assembly certificate of operation shall be valid until its expiration, at which time a new place of assembly certificate of operation shall be required in accordance with the provisions of this article and with the filing requirements of the department.
